eps.d: Comedy series charting the fortunes of the former chat show host. Alan now works for Radio Norwich and is living in a hotel. He has one final meeting with the BBC to see if he can return to television.

Comedy series charting the fortunes of the former chat show host. Alan has been staying at the Linton Travel Tavern for ten weeks, has failed to get a second series and is days away from bankruptcy. Meanwhile, he has fallen in love.

Sitcom about a chat show host who has fallen on hard times. Alan pays the price when he insults Norfolk's farmers on his radio show, and gets into even more difficulty when he accepts the job of fronting a boating holiday promotional video.
Sitcom about a former chat show host. Since Alan is the only guest at the Linton Travel Tavern, it is closed down for refurbishment, leaving Alan at a loose end.
Comedy series charting the fortunes of a former chat show host. Alan puts on a Sunday afternoon version of his show at the hotel and invites some Irish TV executives over to watch it.
Comedy series charting the fortunes of a former chat show host. Dramatic developments at the BBC give Alan a whiff of hope.
After losing his TV show and suffering a breakdown, Alan makes his comeback hosting the third best slot on Radio Norwich.
Broadcaster Alan Partridge's attempts to make a comeback continue. His girlfriend Sonja decides Alan's face will help sell her mugs in Norwich market.
Broadcaster Alan Partridge's attempts to make a comeback continue. A chance meeting affords Alan the opportunity to make inroads into Norwich's social elite.
Alan makes plans to watch the entire back catalogue of James Bond films back to back over the Bank Holiday weekend.

eps.t: I Know What Alan Did Last Summer
eps.d: Concerned about a visit from the Inland Revenue, Alan lies to Sonja about the extent of his friendship with U2 singer Bono.
It's the end of the line for Alan's book, but the house is ready and there's Lynn's baptism to look forward to.
